headline_marked: Myanmar to [[repatriate 300,000 Rohingya]] if security improves in Rakhine
headline: Myanmar to repatriate 300,000 Rohingya if security improves in Rakhine
summary: The Myanmar government has announced its willingness to take back 300,000 refugees provided the security situation in Rakhine State becomes favorable.
details: The Myanmar government has stated that it will repatriate 300,000 Rohingya refugees if the security situation in Rakhine State improves.
This announcement comes amid ongoing efforts to resolve the crisis that has seen hundreds of thousands of Rohingya flee to neighboring Bangladesh.
The government's condition emphasizes that the safety and stability of the region are paramount before any large-scale return can take place.
The repatriation process remains a complex issue, involving diplomatic negotiations and the need for guaranteed safety for the returning refugees.
caption:
Myanmar is open to taking back 300,000 Rohingya refugees—but there is a major condition.

The Myanmar government has stated that it will repatriate 300,000 Rohingya refugees if the security situation in Rakhine State improves.

This announcement comes amid ongoing efforts to resolve the crisis that has seen hundreds of thousands of Rohingya flee to neighboring Bangladesh.

The government's condition emphasizes that the safety and stability of the region are paramount before any large-scale return can take place.

The repatriation process remains a complex issue, involving diplomatic negotiations and the need for guaranteed safety for the returning refugees.

headline_marked: BDT 7.1 million [[found in donation box of Shahjalal Mazar]]
headline: BDT 7.1 million found in donation box of Shahjalal Mazar
summary: The collection includes cash, foreign currency, gold, and silver items, discovered during a routine check of the shrine's donation boxes.
details: Authorities discovered BDT 7.1 million in cash along with foreign currency, gold, and silver ornaments in the donation boxes of the Hazrat Shahjalal Mazar in Sylhet.
The funds were recovered during a scheduled opening and counting process of the donation boxes, which are used by pilgrims and visitors to the shrine.
In addition to the Bangladeshi Taka, various foreign currencies were found, reflecting the visitors from different parts of the world who visit the shrine.
Gold and silver items were also among the donations, which are managed by the overall administration of the shrine.
The total amount of cash recovered is BDT 7.1 million, highlighting the significant volume of donations received by the shrine.
caption:
BDT 7.1 million, gold, and silver found in a single donation box!

Authorities discovered BDT 7.1 million in cash along with foreign currency, gold, and silver ornaments in the donation boxes of the Hazrat Shahjalal Mazar in Sylhet.

The funds were recovered during a scheduled opening and counting process of the donation boxes, which are used by pilgrims and visitors to the shrine.

In addition to the Bangladeshi Taka, various foreign currencies were found, reflecting the visitors from different parts of the world who visit the shrine.

Gold and silver items were also among the donations, which are managed by the overall administration of the shrine.

The total amount of cash recovered is BDT 7.1 million, highlighting the significant volume of donations received by the shrine.
